name: olea-core
description: olea-core — the Obsidian-free half: markdown and block handling, indexing, FSRS scheduling, session assembly, mastery. No Obsidian import, ever (INV-1).
//main: Source, not dist, deliberately — the same reasoning as `types` below, extended to runtime resolution. vitest/Vite resolve the *entry* through `main`, not `types`, so a dist-pointing `main` made `pnpm -r test` fail on a clean clone (olea-synthetic and olea-plugin could not resolve olea-core before it was built). This package is private and never published; the shipped plugin bundle is produced by esbuild from TS source.
//types: Points at source, not dist, deliberately. Consumers in this workspace must typecheck without olea-core having been built first — CI runs typecheck before build on a fresh clone, and a warm local dist/ hides the breakage. Source types are also never stale.
